end.summary:
Classified natural resources as renewable/non-renewable and biotic/abiotic.
Answered 2 of 3 classification attempts without help.
Identified groundwater as abiotic and coal as non-renewable.
Explained that coal causes smoke and sunlight can generate electricity without smoke.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised classifying resources and explaining renewable, non-renewable, biotic, and abiotic categories. They used examples such as groundwater, coal, sunlight, trees, and animals, and explained pollution from burning coal. At home, ask Saanvi to sort six household or environmental examples into two pairs of categories and explain each choice in one sentence.
